mapper.insert: INSERT INTO borrow_record (user_id, physical_work_id, physical_copy_id, borrowed_at, returned_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{physicalWorkId}, #{physicalCopyId}, #{borrowedAt}, #{returnedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT br.id, br.user_id, br.physical_copy_id, br.borrowed_at, br.returned_at, w.title AS title, c.copy_no AS copy_no, IFNULL(c.deleted, 0) AS copy_deleted, IFNULL(w.deleted, 0) AS work_deleted FROM borrow_record br LEFT JOIN physical_copy c ON c.id = br.physical_copy_id LEFT JOIN physical_work w ON w.id = br.physical_work_id WHERE br.user_id = #{userId} AND (br.returned_at IS NULL OR br.returned_at >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 30 DAY)) ORDER BY CASE WHEN br.returned_at IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, br.borrowed_at DESC
